plan: reports/plans/2026-10-28_plan_qwen-sft.md, Amendment 1 and its Gates; E40's results/predictions.json stands unedited for E40
filed: 2026-10-28, before any stage of experiments/qwen_sft/amend1.py; values marked provisional are replaced by the rehearsal's measurements (results/amend1_rehearse/) before the pod run, and never after it
scored_by: experiments/qwen_sft/run.py `score` (rules) and `Job.check` (early: each missed check stops the job; --rehearse logs it instead)
quantities: as results/predictions.json, with: F1 = SFT under transformers.get_cosine_schedule_with_warmup(10, 100), peak 1e-5, clip 1.0; read steps = rules.read_steps; the positive control's teacher = W0 + the change of offsets alpha*R (R ~ N(0,1), seed 0) on the alive columns, alpha sized so KL(teacher || W0) on the fixed rows equals rules.B_rate.target_kl (amended 2026-10-28; was F1's KL to start at its first read step); maths-row readings scored by rule M against W0's maths reading at seeds 0-2 in G1

G_control.rule: as E40: G1's FineWeb masked KL and seed-0 adversary within the relative tolerances of experiments/qwen_adversary (filed numbers, not read from any results file); a NaN misses

G.rule: as E40 (reported; G1 does not stop on it)

L_control.rule: control: L's KL to start after one AdamW step at 1e-5 within +-tol (relative) of E40's step 1 on the same batch and rows; a missing value or NaN misses

L_scaling.rule: KL at 1e-6 over KL at 1e-5 in [band] inclusive (first-order scaling gives about 0.01); a zero KL at 1e-5 or NaN misses

read_steps.rule: D1 and T1 read steps: fixed, plus the first saved step whose KL to start >= kl_min when it is not already one of them; applied after F1; when B's budget allows fewer, the smallest step not in fixed goes first, never 10 or 100. Mirrored in amend1.py's config (asserted equal at start); the user may change it

T0.rule: positive control (replaces E40's T0): teacher training at B's chosen rate towards W0 + a random change the student can match exactly, sized as B's (B_rate.target_kl), for the steps of steps_rule; fall = fp32 KL(teacher || student) on the fixed rows (Job.fixed_rows: the first 4 maths rows and the first 4 FineWeb evaluation rows, the rows B reads) after the last step / the same at step 0 <= fall_max, and the trained student's FineWeb adversary ratio in [band] inclusive; a zero, missing or non-finite step-0 reading is a NaN fall and misses
T0.steps_rule: the fixed rows read every read_every steps; training ends at the first reading whose fall is <= fall_max; no such reading by steps_max (amend1.t0_steps; amend1.py asserts the config's cap equal to steps_max) misses and stops the job at once, before the FineWeb adversary
T0.sources: fall_max: an estimate, not a measurement: check_teacher (job 40673) read 0.59 after 300 steps at 1e-5 on the rehearsal's 16 columns per site; the full alive set spreads the same target KL over ~100x more columns, so alpha is smaller and the same steps should go further; B measures it on the card. steps: the 300 filed before had no source (TR's bf16 training-batch curves), so they come from B's measured curve, capped at the earlier 300. Amended 2026-10-28 (second review): the log-linear extrapolation is replaced by reading until the fall is reached, and the size by B's target_kl, because the measured curves bend (check_teacher, job 40673: 0.702 at step 100 and 0.590 at 300 at 1e-5, where the extrapolation through step 100 gives 0.5 at 196) and B's curve (job 40691: 0.867 at 50 and 0.718 at 100 at 1e-5, 0.942 and 0.725 at 3e-5) was measured at target_kl, while F1's first-read KL (0.022 in the full-size rehearsal F1) is about 2x larger; read_every 50 = B_rate's reading interval; cap 300 as filed

P0.rule: as E40 (A0 accuracy; F1's step-0 readings exactly 0)

P1.rule: as E40, on F1 at step 100

P2.rule: as E40, re-pointed: D1's ratio at its first read step <= step1_max holds; at step 100 > line 'sees the update', <= line 'blind on web text'

P4.rule: as E40, on T1 at every read step

P5.rule: teacher training over do-nothing on maths rows at step 100: ratio = T1's adversary / D1's (same seed) <= ratio_max; a seed-0 ratio in [band] inclusive is re-read at seeds 1 and 2 (both states) and the mean of the per-seed ratios decides

P6.rule: accuracy: F1's step-100 GSM8K strict drop-rule accuracy minus A0's, paired on the problems fitting at both, in [band] inclusive (E40's constant-rate fine-tune fell by 0.16); no pairs or NaN misses

B_rate.rule: B, at the full alive set: the positive control (target KL(teacher || W0) target_kl on the fixed rows, alpha set on those rows) from zero offsets for max(reads) steps at each of `rates`; fp32 KL(teacher || student) on the fixed rows (the same rows at every reading) at each step in `reads`. A rate qualifies when every reading is present and finite, the step-0 reading is > 0, the readings fall strictly (KL(100) < KL(50) < KL(0); a tie does not), and KL(100) / KL(0) <= ratio_max. Teacher training (T0, T1) runs at the largest qualifying rate; none qualifies: stop
B_rate.sources: rates: check_teacher (job 40673, fp32, rehearsal sizes) measured 1e-4 diverging (x3.3 at step 25) and 1e-5 falling to 0.875, 0.702 and 0.590 of the start at steps 25, 100 and 300; 3e-5 lies between them. ratio_max 0.9: a fall the fixed rows show and batch noise cannot (they are fixed). target_kl: as filed
B_rate.edge_cases: zero start: does not qualify (no positive start; no division); NaN or missing reading: does not qualify; a tie between readings: does not qualify; KL(100)/KL(0) exactly 0.9: qualifies (r9, inclusive); both rates qualify: 3e-5; neither: stop (a rehearsal goes on at the config's 1e-5 and T0's cap)
B_rate.added: 2026-10-28, after the code review of Amendment 1, before any paid stage; replaced 2026-10-28 (see amended)

M.rule: the maths pass test (the user accepted maths-text scoring, 2026-10-28): a state's maths-row adversary over W0's maths reference on this card (G1's mean over seeds 0-2); the seed-0 ratio decides unless it lies in [band] inclusive, then seeds 1 and 2 are read and the mean of the three ratios decides; pass <= line. Scored for D1 (reading: 'pass' = the test does not see the update) and T1 at step 100
M.added: 2026-10-28, after the code review of Amendment 1, before any stage that reads it

three_starts.rule: as E40 for every FineWeb ratio; the spend guard stops extra starts once this job's spend exceeds guard_share x --budget-left (the seed-0 ratio then decides, reread_skipped_budget recorded)

finite.rule: a NaN or infinity in any loss, gradient norm, KL or adversary reading is a miss

memory.rule: peak GPU memory of a stage <= peak_gb_max, after each adversary start, teacher-training step 2, F's step 1, B's teacher training and the stage's end (the one memory threshold)

bench.rule: B: usable host RAM (physical, cgroup limit) >= host_gb_min; the disk pre-flight fits at the real alive count (before a fetch of the decomposition: at alive_params_prior, E40's count, plus decomp_bytes); B's projection fits --budget-left with 2 read steps

adv_step0.rule: each adversary start's step-0 KL (one pass, random sources), checked as it is logged: B and G1 at a traced seed within tol (relative) of the first runs' traces (experiments/qwen_adversary run.log, E40 G); every other start within [state_low x G1's seed-0 reading, G1's + state_add]

adv_pass.rule: each adversary start's first pass within tol (relative) of B's; reported, not a stop

F_step1.rule: F1's step-1 loss (at W0, the first batch) within loss_tol (relative) of E40's; its rate is 0, so delta-W and the KL to start after it are exactly 0

F_first_live.rule: at the first step with a nonzero rate (step 2): |delta-W| per matrix / (rate x sqrt(numel)) in [band]. Adam's per-entry step is at most about the rate (bound 1.0013 at its second step) and below it where the two first gradients disagree; step 1 at rate 0 has already filled Adam's moments, so the ratio is not 1 within 1e-3
F_first_live.provisional: lower end, from the rehearsal's full-size F1 on the L40

F1_early.rule: F1's KL to start after the first step with a nonzero rate <= kl_max (code check, not a prediction)

teacher_first.rule: teacher training: step 1's training-forward KL (fp32, TF32 matmuls) within fp32_tol (relative) of the fp32 KL(teacher || W0) on the same batch (TF32 off) when that is >= fp32_min; exactly 0 within zero_kl_max when the teacher is W0 (E40's benchmark); at step end_at, the fixed-row fp32 KL(teacher || student) / the same at step 0 <= end_frac: a stop for the positive control (T0), reported for T1, not made in B (its rate rule reads the same ratio)
teacher_first.sources: fp32_tol: about 9x the TF32 gap measured on B's first batch in the rehearsal on the committed code (1.13e-3 relative at both rates, job 40691; amended 2026-10-28 from 0.002, which was 8x check_teacher's 2.4e-4 on T3's first batch, job 40673, and left a 1.8x margin over 40691's reading). end_frac: B_rate's ratio_max, the same reading at the same step (the 0.7 filed before came from TR's bf16 training-batch curves and had no source)

reported: every number of every stage; maths-row readings of D1, T1 and the positive control against W0's maths readings at seeds 0-2 (unscored); A0's first batch against the earlier run's answers (share differing); the read steps chosen; the benchmark projection with its worst-case re-reads; B's positive-control fixed-row readings and training curves at both rates; T1's fixed-row readings at steps 0 and 100 per read step; the rehearsal's list of checks missed beyond those expected at tiny size (rehearsal.json)
